notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
[list][*]More relaxing, piano background music
[*]The old song is still there - try to find out when it starts playing!
[*]New dot sounds
[*]Reworked levels 83, 86 and 91 - this should make finishing Hard Mode easier
[*]Hard Mode now unlocks when finishing the last level
[*]Redesigned logo
[*]Background animations in main menu
[*]Bugfixes and small tweaks all through the game[/list]
